---
title: "Native run lifecycle"
subtitle: "Live result → Commit → post-commit actions → origin-aware closeout"
---

## Capability-owned UI

Production capability screens should look and behave like the task they perform. Rich interaction belongs in module-owned UI where warranted; a generic generated form is not an acceptable substitute when it would make the capability awkward.

## Live current result

While the user works, current outputs should remain visible on the same screen. The result is **working state** until finalised. Rotation and other ordinary lifecycle changes should preserve meaningful working state.

## Tap-to-copy

Every displayed calculated or returned scalar/text value should expose its primary clipboard projection. Copy the useful value, not a decorative label. For example, a Plus Code card copies the code rather than `Plus Code: …`.

## Commit

**Commit is the finalisation boundary.** It freezes the canonical payload for that run. Where feasible, the same capability screen then reveals post-commit actions such as copy, share, save, full JSON and Done.

Commit does not imply that MethodMesh must persist an internal copy. Persistence is capability-specific and should not be introduced by default merely because a result was finalised.

## Closeout depends on origin

| Launch origin | Successful closeout |
|---|---|
| MethodMesh app / normal preset | Dashboard |
| Android widget | Android desktop |
| ODK/XLSForm | Return to ODK with projected results |
| Protocol | Return to protocol runner |
| Schedule | Return to schedule runner/appropriate schedule flow |

Cancel should unwind to the same origin unless a blocking error genuinely needs to be surfaced.
